scenes.visual: Title card: Four Cells and One Switch.

scenes.tts: At each division of the bristle lineage, one sister hears Notch. But where in the lineage does Notch act?
scenes.visual: The four-cell bristle tree from chapter one, with blank Notch labels. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: At each division of the bristle lineage, one sister hears Notch. But where in the lineage does Notch act?

scenes.tts: Notch is a receptor that signals only between touching cells. A ligand called Delta, on the neighbour, activates it.
scenes.visual: Two touching cells; a Notch receptor on one meets a ligand labelled Delta on the other. Link card: the Notch signaling lesson.
scenes.narration: Notch is a receptor that signals only between touching cells. A ligand called Delta, on the neighbour, activates it.

scenes.tts: When it is activated, it is cut. Its inner part can then switch genes on.
scenes.visual: The receptor is cut; its inner part moves into the nucleus and a gene lights up.
scenes.narration: When it is activated, it is cut. Its inner part can then switch genes on.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety, Volker Hartenstein and James Posakony used a temperature-sensitive allele of Notch.
scenes.caption: In 1990, Volker Hartenstein and James Posakony used a temperature-sensitive allele of Notch.
scenes.visual: Name card: Hartenstein and Posakony, 1990. A thermometer icon beside the word Notch.
scenes.narration: In 1990, Volker Hartenstein and James Posakony used a temperature-sensitive allele of Notch.

scenes.tts: The mutant protein works at a low temperature and fails at a higher one.
scenes.visual: The thermometer: cool, Notch drawn working; warm, Notch drawn greyed out.
scenes.narration: The mutant protein works at a low temperature and fails at a higher one.

scenes.tts: So warming the animal removes Notch for a chosen window. They warmed fly pupae in short pulses.
scenes.visual: Red heat pulses appear as short bars on the pupal timeline.
scenes.narration: So warming the animal removes Notch for a chosen window. They warmed fly pupae in short pulses.

scenes.tts: First, pulses in the first fourteen hours after the pupa formed. That is before the bristle precursors divide.
scenes.caption: First, pulses in the first 14 hours after the pupa formed. That is before the bristle precursors divide.
scenes.visual: A pulse bar covers 0 to 14 hours on the timeline. Label: before the precursors divide.
scenes.narration: First, pulses in the first 14 hours after the pupa formed. That is before the bristle precursors divide.

scenes.tts: These gave extra precursors in place of skin cells.
scenes.visual: A patch of skin: several skin cells become precursors.
scenes.narration: These gave extra precursors in place of skin cells.

scenes.tts: Normally the new precursor signals to its neighbours through Notch, and they stay skin cells. Without Notch, they become precursors too.
scenes.visual: One precursor sends Notch arrows to the surrounding skin cells, which stay skin. Then the arrows grey out and the neighbours turn into precursors.
scenes.narration: Normally the new precursor signals to its neighbours through Notch, and they stay skin cells. Without Notch, they become precursors too.

scenes.tts: Each extra precursor formed a normal bristle.
scenes.visual: Each extra precursor grows a normal bristle.
scenes.narration: Each extra precursor formed a normal bristle.

scenes.tts: Now warm the pupae from fourteen to twenty hours. That is around the time the precursors divide.
scenes.caption: Now warm the pupae from 14 to 20 hours. That is around the time the precursors divide.
scenes.visual: A pulse bar covers 14 to 20 hours. Label: around the time the precursors divide.
scenes.narration: Now warm the pupae from 14 to 20 hours. That is around the time the precursors divide.

scenes.tts: Notch now fails at the divisions of the lineage. What cells should the sense organs contain?
scenes.visual: Prompt card: Pulse while the lineage divides. Predict the cells. The tree is shown with every cell blank.
scenes.narration: Notch now fails at the divisions of the lineage. What cells should the sense organs contain?

scenes.visual: Hold on the prompt. A small timer icon.

scenes.tts: The sense organs were made only of neurons. There was no shaft and no socket.
scenes.visual: Reveal: the tree fills with neurons only. The bristle drawing loses its shaft and socket.
scenes.narration: The sense organs were made only of neurons. There was no shaft and no socket.

scenes.visual: Hold on the reveal.

scenes.tts: Walk it down the map. With no Notch, the first division gives two inner precursors.
scenes.visual: The SOP division plays again: both daughters turn grey and are labelled inner precursor.
scenes.narration: Walk it down the map. With no Notch, the first division gives two inner precursors.

scenes.tts: Each inner precursor then gives two neurons, not a neuron and a sheath cell.
scenes.visual: Each grey inner precursor divides into two grey neurons. Four neurons in all.
scenes.narration: Each inner precursor then gives two neurons, not a neuron and a sheath cell.

scenes.tts: So the neuron is a Notch-off fate. The outer branch, which makes the shaft and socket, needs Notch.
scenes.visual: The neuron gets a grey Notch-off tag; the outer branch gets a teal tag: needs Notch.
scenes.narration: So the neuron is a Notch-off fate. The outer branch, which makes the shaft and socket, needs Notch.

scenes.tts: Notch is used once to pick the precursor. It is used again to split its progeny.
scenes.visual: The timeline again, with two marks: pick the precursor; split its progeny.
scenes.narration: Notch is used once to pick the precursor. It is used again to split its progeny.

scenes.visual: Hold on the reveal.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-six, Ming Guo, Lily Jan and Yuh Nung Jan went further. Notch works as a two-way switch at each division.
scenes.caption: In 1996, Ming Guo, Lily Jan and Yuh Nung Jan went further. Notch works as a two-way switch at each division.
scenes.visual: Name card: Guo, Jan and Jan, 1996. A two-way switch icon appears at each division of the tree.
scenes.narration: In 1996, Ming Guo, Lily Jan and Yuh Nung Jan went further. Notch works as a two-way switch at each division.

scenes.tts: That fills in the map. At the first division, the inner precursor is the Notch-off daughter. The outer precursor hears Notch.
scenes.visual: Table builds row by row. Row 1: SOP division; inner precursor grey (Notch-off), outer precursor teal (Notch-on).
scenes.narration: That fills in the map. At the first division, the inner precursor is the Notch-off daughter. The outer precursor hears Notch.

scenes.tts: At the outer precursor's division, the hair cell is Notch-off. The socket cell hears Notch.
scenes.visual: Row 2: outer precursor; hair cell grey, socket cell teal.
scenes.narration: At the outer precursor's division, the hair cell is Notch-off. The socket cell hears Notch.

scenes.tts: At the inner precursor's division, the neuron is Notch-off. The sheath cell hears Notch.
scenes.visual: Row 3: inner precursor; neuron grey, sheath cell teal.
scenes.narration: At the inner precursor's division, the neuron is Notch-off. The sheath cell hears Notch.

scenes.tts: So at every division, one daughter hears Notch. The sisters sit side by side, and either could signal. What stops one from hearing?
scenes.visual: Close-up of two touching sisters with Notch arrows pointing both ways. A question mark over one of them.
scenes.narration: So at every division, one daughter hears Notch. The sisters sit side by side, and either could signal. What stops one from hearing?

scenes.tts: Notch is a switch used at every division. One daughter hears it, and one does not.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: Notch splits the lineage at every division.
scenes.narration: Notch is a switch used at every division. One daughter hears it, and one does not.

scenes.visual: Hold on the takeaway card.
